contracts.limit: Shared numeric/color motion remains published. RC.12 adds Web paths/tangent orientation, rotateX/Y with parent CSS perspective and one outer zero-spread CSS shadow. Android elevation/translationZ remain native-specific; no pixel/performance equivalence is implied.
RC.12 supports Web rotateX/Y with application-owned parent perspective. Authored projective target baselines and 3D FLIP/layout remain unsupported; native pixels may differ.

Shared numeric/color motion remains published. RC.12 adds Web paths/tangent orientation, rotateX/Y with parent CSS perspective and one outer zero-spread CSS shadow. Android elevation/translationZ remain native-specific; no pixel/performance equivalence is implied.

RC.12 optional Web inspector with explicit application handles and shared bounded semantic replay. App supplies replay adapter/clock. No automatic OS gesture/sensor injection, GPU or native sampling measurements.

Maintainer-selected simulator/emulator acceptance covers interruption, keyed/recycled/deleted return targets, rotation, large text, background/resume and zero terminal navigation resources. Physical hardware remains unverified for this candidate.

Maintainer-selected simulator/emulator acceptance covers fling, short pull/refresh/error retry, late layout/reload/rotation anchors, large text, short/empty content and terminal native-resource cleanup. Physical hardware remains unverified.

Actual Safari simulator and Chrome emulator keyboard/permission/source/lifecycle acceptance passed. Candidate keyboard corrections handle resized and panned viewports and inactive VirtualKeyboard. Emulated sensor readings and a vibration request do not prove physical output.

Published native/Web support is rotation/gravity. New native proper/linear acceleration, angular rate and magnetic field are local/unpublished; Web does not expose them. Native hardware timestamps/frequency differ from browser event timestamps/delivery throttling.

Static-image Metal/AGSL pixels, ownership and cold/warm native-draw/texture acceptance passed in the selected emulator/simulator scope. Browser rendering differs. Arbitrary live-view shaders and physical GPU performance are not supported claims.

Native adapters published since RC.11. New DOM entries reuse the Web runtime; actual React 19 Strict Mode, Angular 22 hydration, Svelte 5 and Solid 1 consumers validated. Candidate not merged/published; renderer/version boundaries stay explicit.

Exact compiled gallery/sheet/list recipes passed real iOS/Android interactions with reviewed recordings. The first matched release-app comparison has a reproducible protocol and retained per-run traces; see its result summary for scope and metrics. Local and unpublished.

RC.12.1 publishes browser proper/linear acceleration and gyroscope event adapters with shared acquisition and explicit availability; magnetic field reports unavailable. Overall physical browser delivery/accuracy acceptance remains pending in #385.
Browser options support curves/presets and reduced motion, but reusable helper exports and scoped reduced-motion read/observation need an explicit portable public contract.

Web element-relative scroll ranges automatically track layout with explicit anchor/ancestor restrictions. Structured surface conflicts retain string details and geometry/recreation guidance. Native numeric scroll contracts remain unchanged. Mavis adoption is tracked separately in getcortexlabs/mavis-ui#262.

iPadOS hover API and Android mouse/hovering stylus only; physical pointer accessory unverified. Android pointer replay is explicitly injected. Web custom adapters execute JS per frame. Retained native drawing reduces host count but did not beat the equivalent compound-path baseline in CPU or allocations on the measured ASUS device. Available in 0.1.0-rc.12; physical accessory acceptance remains open.

Available in 0.1.0-rc.12; physical acceptance remains open. Audio runs at fixed rate 1 and does not seek. Native screen recordings have no audio; physical iOS silent-switch behavior remains unverified. Inspector timings cover JS work, not native rendering or GPU.

Available in 0.1.0-rc.12.1: retained ownership, behavior coordination, glyph-clipped text, articulated 2D boxes and preference helpers. Sensors use browser events; magneticField reports unavailable. Overall physical sensor acceptance remains pending in #385; emulator/injected readings do not prove hardware support.

Standalone source Swift Package, iOS 17+/macOS 14+. Initial finite poses and 13 generated recipes, extended by the swiftui-expansion candidate below. Actual iOS simulator/macOS acceptance, no JavaScript/NativeScript or performance parity. Web recipes reused and recorded.

Standalone iOS 17+/macOS 14+ source candidate covering scoped sampled motion, native interaction, composition and retained graphics. Apple points/native DIP/Web CSS pixels; platform rendering and event timing differ. Polyline paths only, finite property-target behaviors, bounded retained Canvas, no sensors or hardware/performance parity. Native and Web local acceptance and EN/PT/ES/ZH recordings are provided; merge/publication pending.

Standalone iOS 17+/macOS 14+ source candidate: finite scalar keyframes, focal gestures, fixed-height realized reorder, owned in-app drop zones, bounded Canvas particles and articulated symbol rigs. Existing Web APIs reused in packed framework consumers. Apple points and CSS pixels, platform input/rendering differences, no virtualization, OS file drop, mesh/IK or performance parity; merge/publication pending.
